sources.entry: Firefly III - Firefly III is a modern financial manager. It helps you to keep track of your money and make budget forecasts. It supports credit cards, has an advanced rule engine and can import data from many banks. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Firefly III is a free, self-hosted personal finance manager for tracking expenses and income, budgeting, and generating financial reports.
summary.what_it_does: Firefly III lets you record income and expenses using double-entry bookkeeping, organized with budgets, categories and tags. It supports recurring transactions and a rule engine that handles transactions automatically based on rules you define. Piggy banks let you save toward goals, and income and expense reports and charts give an overview of your finances. Data can be imported using several tools, and it offers a REST JSON API covering most of the application. Two-factor authentication and any currency are supported. The README says it runs on your own server and does not contact external servers unless you tell it to.
use_cases: save toward goals with piggy banks
automatically categorize bank transactions with rules
import bank data into a personal finance tool
how_to_run: Install on your own server (see the documentation)
Run using Docker (a Docker image is provided)
notable: Self-hosted, with no cloud dependency; does not contact external servers unless told to
Rule engine for automatic transaction handling
Recurring transactions and piggy banks for savings goals
REST JSON API covering most of the application
caveats: Aimed at people who are somewhat tech-savvy and comfortable tinkering with self-hosted servers
Some hosting options (Hostinger, PikaPods, LumaDock) are commercial or paid
